## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Split, ETS/SNAIVE, differencing, ARIMA
```{r bridge-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=20}
library(fpp3)
beer <- aus_production |>
  select(Quarter, Beer) |>
  filter(!is.na(Beer))
beer_train <- beer |> filter(Quarter <= max(Quarter) - 8)
beer_test  <- beer |> filter(Quarter >  max(Quarter) - 8)
c(train = nrow(beer_train), test = nrow(beer_test))

fit <- beer_train |>
  model(
    snaive = SNAIVE(Beer),
    ets = ETS(Beer),
    arima = ARIMA(Beer)
  )
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = nrow(beer_test))
fc |> accuracy(beer) |> select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MASE)

beer_train |> gg_tsdisplay(Beer, plot_type = "partial")
beer_train |> gg_tsdisplay(difference(Beer), plot_type = "partial")
fit |> select(ets) |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("No — use hold-out / TS CV across families", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Yes — AICc is universal"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```


```{r submit-server, context="server"}

  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
```
